dialogues.title: Checking in for a flight
dialogues.context: Havaalanındasın, check-in bankosundasın. Bir bagajın var ve koltuk tercihini söyleyeceksin.

lines.en: Good morning. Passport and booking reference, please.
lines.tr: Günaydın. Pasaport ve rezervasyon numarası, lütfen.
alternatives: Morning! Can I see your passport?

lines.en: Here you go.
alternatives: Here they are.
Sure, here you are.

lines.en: Thank you. Do you have any bags to check?
alternatives: Any luggage to check in today?

lines.en: Just this one, and a carry-on.
lines.tr: Sadece bu, bir de el bagajı.
alternatives: One bag, plus my carry-on.

lines.en: Could you put it on the scale, please?
alternatives: Pop it on the scale for me.

lines.en: That's fine — just under the limit. Window or aisle?
lines.tr: Uygun, limitin hemen altında. Cam kenarı mı koridor mu?
alternatives: You're under the limit. Window or aisle seat?

lines.en: Window, please.
alternatives: Window if you have one.

lines.en: Here's your boarding pass. Gate B12.
alternatives: Boarding pass — you're at gate B12.

lines.en: What time does boarding start?
alternatives: When do we board?

lines.en: Twenty past nine, but check the board — gates change.
lines.tr: Dokuzu yirmi geçe, ama ekranı kontrol edin, kapılar değişebiliyor.
alternatives: Nine twenty. Keep an eye on the screens though.

lines.en: Got it. Thanks a lot.
alternatives: Understood — thank you.

lines.en: Have a good flight.
alternatives: Enjoy your flight!

dialogues.title: A missed connection
dialogues.context: İlk uçuşun rötar yaptı ve aktarmanı kaçırdın. Transfer bankosunda çözüm arıyorsun.

lines.en: Next, please. How can I help?
alternatives: Next! What can I do for you?

lines.en: My first flight was late and I missed my connection.
lines.tr: İlk uçuşum geç kaldı ve aktarmamı kaçırdım.
alternatives: I missed my connecting flight — the first one was delayed.

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I see your boarding pass?
lines.tr: Bunu duyduğuma üzüldüm. Biniş kartınızı görebilir miyim?
alternatives: Sorry about that. Boarding pass, please?

lines.en: Here. I was supposed to be in Rome by two.
alternatives: Here you go — I should have landed in Rome at two.

lines.en: Let me see what I can do. Bear with me a second.
lines.tr: Ne yapabilirim bakayım. Bir saniye sabredin.
alternatives: Give me one moment while I check options.

lines.en: There's a seat on the six-forty. Would that work?
lines.tr: Altı kırktaki uçuşta yer var. Uygun olur mu?
alternatives: I can get you on the 6:40. Does that help?

lines.en: Is there anything earlier?
lines.tr: Daha erken bir şey var mı?
alternatives: Nothing sooner than that?

lines.en: I'm afraid that's the first available.
lines.tr: Korkarım en erken müsait olan bu.
alternatives: Sorry, that's the earliest we've got.

lines.en: Fair enough. What about my luggage?
alternatives: Okay. And my checked bag?

lines.en: It'll be transferred automatically. You don't need to do anything.
lines.tr: Otomatik aktarılacak. Bir şey yapmanıza gerek yok.
alternatives: We'll move it for you — nothing for you to do.

lines.en: That's a relief. Do I get a meal voucher?
alternatives: Good to know. Is there any compensation for the wait?

lines.en: Yes, here's a voucher and your new boarding pass.
lines.tr: Evet, işte kuponunuz ve yeni biniş kartınız.
alternatives: Absolutely — voucher and new boarding pass.

lines.en: Thanks for your patience with all this.
alternatives: I really appreciate your help.

dialogues.title: Taking a taxi
dialogues.context: Havaalanından şehir merkezine taksiyle gidiyorsun ve biraz acelen var.

lines.en: Where to?
alternatives: Where are you headed?

lines.en: Could you take me to this address?
alternatives: This address, please.

lines.en: Sure. Hop in, I'll get your bag.
alternatives: No problem — let me take that for you.

lines.en: How much will it be, roughly?
alternatives: Any idea what it'll cost?

lines.en: About thirty, depending on traffic.
alternatives: Thirty or so, if the roads are clear.

lines.en: I'm in a bit of a rush. Is there a faster route?
lines.tr: Biraz acelem var. Daha hızlı bir yol var mı?
alternatives: I'm running late — can we avoid the traffic?

lines.en: I'll take the ring road. Should save ten minutes.
lines.tr: Çevre yolundan gideyim. On dakika kazandırır.
alternatives: We'll go around — quicker this time of day.

lines.en: Perfect, thank you.
alternatives: Sounds good to me.

lines.en: First time here?
alternatives: Have you been here before?

lines.en: Yes. I'm here on business for a few days.
lines.tr: Evet. Birkaç günlüğüne iş için geldim.
alternatives: First time — I'm here for work.

lines.en: This is it, number forty-four.
alternatives: Here we are — forty-four.

lines.en: Great. Keep the change.
alternatives: Thanks a lot — keep the change.

dialogues.title: Buying a train ticket
dialogues.context: Gişedesin, başka bir şehre gitmek için bilet alacaksın. Aktarma olup olmadığını da öğrenmelisin.

lines.en: Hi, where are you traveling to?
alternatives: Hello — where to today?

lines.en: I'd like a one-way ticket to Manchester.
alternatives: One-way to Manchester, please.

lines.en: Single or return?
alternatives: Just one way, or coming back?

lines.en: One way, please. What time does the next train leave?
lines.tr: Tek yön, lütfen. Bir sonraki tren ne zaman kalkıyor?
alternatives: Single. When's the next one?

lines.en: There's one at ten past four.
lines.tr: Dördü on geçe bir tane var.
alternatives: Four ten, in about twenty minutes.

lines.en: Do I need to change trains?
alternatives: Is it direct?

lines.en: Yes, you change at Birmingham. It's a short wait.
lines.tr: Evet, Birmingham'da aktarma var. Kısa bir bekleme.
alternatives: You'll change once, at Birmingham.

lines.en: Which platform is it?
alternatives: What platform do I need?

lines.en: Platform nine, down the stairs and to your right.
alternatives: Nine — downstairs, on the right.

lines.en: How much is it?
alternatives: What's the fare?

lines.en: Thirty-eight fifty. Cash or card?
lines.tr: Otuz sekiz elli. Nakit mi kart mı?
alternatives: That's thirty-eight fifty.

lines.en: Card, please. Thanks, that's a big help.
lines.tr: Kart, lütfen. Teşekkürler, çok yardımcı oldunuz.
alternatives: I'll pay by card — thank you.
